newsitem.title: USA: Equity Residential swaps shares for site.
newsitem.headline: Equity Residential swaps shares for site.

text.p: Equity Residential Properties Trust on Tuesday said it acquired a 256-unit residential property in California from Prudential Real Estate Investors (PREI) in exchange for 692,023 of its shares.
Equity Residential said it issued the shares, which were valued at $45.88 each, to PRISA II, an institutional real estate investment fund managed by Prudential Real Estate Investors.

In exchange, Equity Residential acquired Wood Creek, a property including 76 one-bedroom and 180 two-bedroom units in Pleasant Hill, California. The total consideration paid for the property was $32.3 million, which included $500,000 in transaction costs.

Equity Residential said the way the deal was structured would become a trend in the industry in which investment managers, seeking to improve liquidity of their assets, swap property for equity stakes in real estate investment trusts.

"Institutions such as PREI are actively seeking quality investment partners in public markets to assume ownership of their properties and provide liquidity and attractive returns to their clients," said Douglas Crocker, Equity Residential's president and chief executive.
